summary: M0 model-only verdict: MONITOR @ 0.68. prof.kaya@aegean.edu shows a consistent baseline: 10 successful sign-ins from 89.180.44.17 (MEO, Lisbon, PT) via VPN appliance vpn-edge-02, all from the same device LT-3104 (LMS/mail), MFA prompt count 0 — consistent with the stated "travelling abroad, device + VPN" context. One anomalous event stands out: 2026-10-15 06:40 from 193.140.10.21 (Turkcell, Manisa, TR), mail app, no device_id, no VPN, MFA 0. It is a single successful sign-in from a different country/ASN without the known device or VPN, with no failed logins, no MFA fatigue, no concurrent sessions, and no mail events (0) indicating follow-on activity. This is a weak, unexplained signal rather than confirmed takeover (no contain criteria met) and not sufficiently explained to call benign (travel context accounts for the Portugal VPN sessions, not the Turkcell/Manisa sign-in). No exposure or evidence requiring immediate human escalation. Recommend monitoring the account for repeat anomalous auth from unfamiliar devices/locations.
